question: On April 10, 2024, Zenith Cloud Robotics asks for an unused-term annual cash refund after its March incident. Retrieve its activation date and calculate its March monthly uptime and service credit. Explain whether the annual refund guarantee or an SLA credit is the supported remedy.
single_query: On April 10, 2024, Zenith Cloud Robotics asks for an unused-term annual cash refund after its March incident. Retrieve its activation date and calculate its March monthly uptime and service credit. Explain whether the annual refund guarantee or an SLA credit is the supported remedy.

decomposed_queries.query: What written request deadline and compute usage limit govern annual subscription refunds?
How are downtime and monthly uptime defined, calculated and monitored?
What Enterprise and Professional service credit brackets apply at exact uptime boundaries?
Can service credits become cash refunds and what is the exclusive financial remedy and monthly cap?
